name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.75.1: Ship the Miyoo an icon Onion will draw; Refuse a download built for another machine.
changelog.v2.75.0: Say the clock is wrong when a certificate is not valid yet; Run on the Miyoo Mini Plus under Onion OS; Give a Mac window a menu bar, and the same chords everywhere else; Say what a window's reader does, not which Brick button to press; Read all 40 of a companion's channel slots, not the first eight (and 47 more).
changelog.v2.74.0: Stand a node's facts in two columns where there is room; Preview the row under the list's cursor beside it; Name a sender in the tint their avatar wears; Count MQTT and private messages, and record the farthest node heard and weakest signal; Count delivered and undelivered messages (and 169 more).
changelog.v2.73.0: A full-screen radio firmware install screen; The 1200-baud touch on the Brick, through usbfs; Switch a board between Meshtastic and MeshCore over USB; Install a MeshCore nRF52 over USB by the 1200-baud touch; Check and install a MeshCore radio's firmware from MeshCore's own releases (and 138 more).
changelog.v2.72.0: Install nRF52 radios over BLE through their DFU bootloader; Leave the on-screen keyboard grid out of a desktop window; Move About radio and Radio actions onto the Radio tab; App icon for the macOS and Windows installs; Ship a macOS .dmg and a Windows installer; Install updates on macOS and Windows (and 102 more).
